title: Yellowed Smoky French Flaxseed Canele
description: A smoky and aerated French dish featuring flaxseed, perfect for a brunch mood, this ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is made in an iron teppan and formed into a canele shape.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Whisk together the ground flaxseed, smoked paprika, eggs, granulated sugar, and all purpose flour in a large bowl.
Add the milk, melted unsalted butter, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into the preheated iron teppan and cook for 20 minutes.
Rotate the canele 180 degrees and continue cooking for an additional 15 minutes.
Remove the canele from the teppan and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the Yellowed Smoky French Flaxseed Canele warm.
Optional: dust with powdered sugar before serving.
